detailed_descriptions_html.en:
【 A Tiny Cat. A Huge Mess. 】

One borrowed wand. One very wrong spell.

Now every book, potion, broom, and magical ingredient in the school is scattered across the floor.

Play as a tiny cat and restore the magic school by putting everything back where it belongs.

Play solo or online with up to 3 friends.

【 Sort Everything 】

Every object has a home.

  • Rebuild book series.

  • Sort colorful potions.

  • Match magical ingredients.

  • Return brooms to their racks.

  • Find magical wands hidden throughout the school.

Over 4,500 handcrafted objects are waiting to be organized.

【 Unlock Magical Spells 】

Spells grant helpful abilities that make cleaning faster.

  • Insight – Reveal matching items on ground.

  • Assemble – Summon matching items.

  • Homing Sense – Reveal where an item belongs.

  • Auto Shelving – Place everything you're carrying at once.

Choose the spell that fits your playstyle.

【 Restore the School 】

Explore six handcrafted rooms, each introducing new objects and fresh sorting challenges.

As you clean, the school slowly returns to normal.

【 A Cozy Cleanup 】

No timers.

No combat.

No fail states.

Just satisfying organization, magical discoveries, and a cozy adventure for 1–4 players.

【 Features 】

  • Solo or online co-op for 1–4 players

  • Unlock magical spells

  • Sort over 4,500 handcrafted objects

  • Restore six unique rooms

  • Relaxing gameplay with no pressure
